extension.summary: Install video add-ons from the Tony.7.Bones repos
extension.description: Pick which video add-ons to install (POV, The Loop, Sports HD, Umbrella). Each is installed with its full dependency closure, resolved live from the repositories already on this box, then enabled so it works straight away. Run the main Tony.7.Bones Setup first so the source repositories are present.
extension.news: The Loop's Dailymotion is installed-but-disabled (durable across Loop updates) instead of excluded. Dailymotion is installed as The Loop's normal required dependency — so The Loop's dependency check is satisfied with no broken flag and no required-dependency lock — then disabled at the end of the run so it never actually runs. Because it stays installed, this survives Loop auto-updates with no re-patching. Only Dailymotion is disabled; The Loop, POV and Sports HD stay enabled and browse normally. Still stamps origins and skips optional dependencies (no Google Drive / cloud resolvers).
